subject: Private environment carveout, capacity top-up and renewal checklist
messages:
From: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@medlinkhealth.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medlinkhealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private environment carveout and renewal planning

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — our renewal is coming up in January and we need to align on two things that must be in scope for the next term:

1) An isolated private environment (VPC/on-prem carveout) for our analytics workloads — must be physically separate from our existing cluster and have strict network egress controls.
2) Capacity top-up: estimate ~3 additional inference clusters to cover growth (peak 1.2M tokens/day) + a warm standby for DR.

Can we get a proposed SOW and indicative pricing that ties to the renewal? We’re under an accelerated compliance window (internal audit + regional data residency checks) so we need delivery targets and a clear handoff plan. I attached a capacity worksheet describing current usage.

Also looping in procurement in case there are paperwork or PO timeline constraints.

Thanks,
Elaine Chu
Director of Platform Engineering
Medlink Health
Attachments: capacity_worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@medlinkhealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private environment carveout and renewal planning

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet. We can absolutely support an isolated VPC carveout + three additional clusters and a warm standby.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Deliverable: new VPC + dedicated clusters (3 active + 1 standby), dedicated KV/caching layer, and strict egress controls with customer-managed routing.
- Timeline: kickoff within 3 weeks of SOW sign (target: 8 weeks to first cluster; full rollout 12 weeks).
- Terms: propose coupling this expansion into renewal — two options: 12-month renewal with one-time capacity top-up fee, or 24-month with 10% uplift discount and staged payments.

I’ve attached an updated SOW draft (Medlink_SOW_v2.pdf) and a rough capacity estimate. Monica and Karthik are copied to help with sizing and delivery commitments. Rafael, can you hold preliminary pricing for the two term options while we confirm final cluster sizing?

Next steps:
1) Review SOW + capacity estimate — note sections 3.2 (isolation boundaries) and 4.1 (SLA & fallback).
2) Quick 30-min call this week to confirm acceptance criteria for the isolated environment and compliance checklist.
3) Procurement: if you can share PO cadence or any legal redlines up front we’ll draft the DocuSign package.

I’m available Thu or Fri afternoon PT for a call.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Medlink_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Medlink carveout — sizing & questions for solutions

Team — internal notes after Elaine’s ask:

Summary of external ask: isolated VPC (or on-prem equivalent), 3 active clusters + 1 warm standby, strict egress, 8–12 week delivery window, tie to renewal.

Sizing assumptions I used for the attached estimate:
- Peak tokens/day: 1.2M (worksheet) -> modeled as 600 concurrent sessions with avg seq len 512
- Cluster config: 4x A100-80GB equiv nodes per cluster (inference-optimized), KV cache persistent per cluster, network isolation via dedicated ENIs and NAT gateways managed by customer.
- Storage: persistent model store + encrypted snapshots; daily backup window outside business hours.

Questions for solutions/ops:
1) Do we have a reserved instance SKU that maps cleanly to the 3+1 topology for pricing?
2) Any constraints if Medlink insists on geofenced nodes within eu-west-1 only? Latency to their frontends is fine but need region-specific kernels.
3) Can we provide a temporary canary cluster on hosted infra while private infra provisions, for a 2-week validation window?

Attached: redwood_capacity_estimate.pdf (internal estimate).

Please reply with line items we should include in the SOW (e.g., DR RTO, patching cadence, encryption at rest KMS options).

Thanks,
Kim
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 14:15:00 -0800

Quick pricing readout and commercial options:

Option A — 12 month renewal + one-time capacity top-up
- One-time expansion fee (setup/provisioning/secure onboarding): $120,000
- Monthly run-rate delta (capacity + standby): $38,000/mo
- SLA: standard enterprise SLA (99.9% uptime), option to add premium SLA for +$6k/mo.

Option B — 24 month commitment (preferred for customer)
- One-time expansion fee: $95,000 (discounted)
- Monthly run-rate delta: $34,200/mo (10% discounted)
- Includes 1 annual on-site/remote compliance review and two emergency capacity bursts/year (subject to notice).

Notes:
- If Medlink requires eu-west-1-only geofence, add +8% for reserved capacity and licensing constraints.
- We should propose DocuSign for SOW + amendment to the master services agreement.
- Rafael will prepare a clean commercial worksheet to share with Procurement.

Rafael
Senior Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
